cars.summary: The Nash-Healey was a distinctive early postwar international sports-car venture. Nash supplied the drivetrain, Healey built the rolling chassis and Pinin Farina completed the Italian coachwork. This combined American power with British sports-car engineering and Italian design in a dedicated production road car. The programme’s real endurance-racing heritage reinforces its significance beyond rarity or price.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The Nash-Healey was a distinctive early postwar international sports-car venture. Nash supplied the drivetrain, Healey built the rolling chassis and Pinin Farina completed the Italian coachwork. This combined American power with British sports-car engineering and Italian design in a dedicated production road car. The programme’s real endurance-racing heritage reinforces its significance beyond rarity or price.

facts.title: Programme endurance heritage
facts.explanation: Motor Sport’s contemporary 1952 Le Mans report records Leslie Johnson and Tommy Wisdom finishing third in a Nash-Healey. This supports the programme’s sporting significance; their competition car is distinct from the selected 1953 production convertible.

cars.generation: Original prewar chain-driven TT Replica factory production-road sports-car family
cars.variant: Meadows four-cylinder — 1934 BMK 102, September 2022 road-feature architecture reference
cars.specification_market: 1934 BMK 102 as documented in the 30 September 2022 first-hand road feature. Architecture and original-model identity are distinguished from the newly built restoration engine. Its 111 bhp at 6050 rpm, 9.65:1 compression, modified trim and earlier AC six-cylinder swap are not 1934 factory specifications. The original TT Replica model is not a modern kit or reproduction. Meadows/Blackburne/Gough tunes, body changes and racing derivatives do not add separate counts.
cars.summary: The original TT Replica embodies Frazer Nash’s distinctive chain-drive sports-car tradition, with an outside gear lever and an unusually direct connection between driver and chassis. First-hand road driving of BMK 102 describes quick changes and throttle-directed cornering, alongside cold-brake pull and initial understeer. This established sporting identity and unconventional mechanical layout justify one original family entry; Replica is the historic model name.

facts.title: Why this car belongs
facts.explanation: The original TT Replica embodies Frazer Nash’s distinctive chain-drive sports-car tradition, with an outside gear lever and an unusually direct connection between driver and chassis. First-hand road driving of BMK 102 describes quick changes and throttle-directed cornering, alongside cold-brake pull and initial understeer. This established sporting identity and unconventional mechanical layout justify one original family entry; Replica is the historic model name.
